description: This file contains C# source code defining classes, interfaces, and records related to Orleans grains for journaling tests, including durable state management and complex state handling.

classes.name: TestDurableGrainState
classes.description: A record representing the state of a durable grain with a name and counter.

classes.name: TestDurableGrain
classes.description: A durable grain class implementing ITestDurableGrain, managing simple state with get/set methods.

classes.name: TestDurableGrainWithComplexState
classes.description: A durable grain class implementing ITestDurableGrainWithComplexState, managing complex state including a person and a list.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the name from the grain's state.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Returns the counter from the grain's state.

methods.name: SetTestValues
methods.description: Sets the test values for name and counter in the grain's state.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: GetPerson
methods.description: Returns the person object from the complex state.

methods.name: GetItems
methods.description: Returns the list of items from the complex state.

methods.name: SetTestValues
methods.description: Sets the test values for person and items in the complex state.
